title: Lionel Parts: the 6,932 unfinished Trainz links — 717 to a real Trainz page, 6,215 emptied (Master Version 2.87)
rule: Cells holding only "https://www.trainz.com/products/" (left by the 2026-09-14 Trainz parts-diagram read when Trainz had no page). A real link is written ONLY when the Trainz page has exactly the same model number, maker Lionel, and is the same part by name (colour, finish, quantity, with/without agree); pairs not settled by rule were read by hand, and every proposed link was re-read by an independent reviewer (the 5 it questioned are emptied). Otherwise the cell is emptied. Lionel Parts has no Row ID: cells are keyed by sheet row + item number + description + the exact old cell.
